title: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons / Oracle of Ages (The Oracles Project)
description: The Oracles Project - A faithful, moddable port of Oracle of Ages and Oracle of Seasons for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android: your own ROM runs unmodified in SameBoy or mGBA, with a widescreen Enhanced mode, European languages, item hotkeys, Lua mods and fan games.
